qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. She should apologise to me. I didn't start it but when she yelled at me I didn't shut up. I have no regrets. You should be proud of me.
2. I have to tell you something. I've read your poems. They're great, so sensitive and deep. My girl is a real poet. I love being your mum.
3. You can't ignore the reality. Being honest is hard but I'll be with you when you break the news to him. The sooner you do it, the better you'll feel.
4. Your last drawings are really fantastic. Everybody can see that. Don't listen to what your classmates say. They don't get it anyway. I think they're probably jealous of your talent.
5. No one has to know what you're going through right now. People have no clue about anything. Keep it to yourself for your own good. Just trust me.
items: 1 — I didn't start it, I didn't shut up, no regrets.
2 — I've read your poems — you're a real poet. I love being your mum.
3 — Being honest is hard, but the sooner you do it, the better.
4 — Your drawings are fantastic. Don't listen to your classmates — they're jealous.
5 — No one has to know. Keep it to yourself.

What did Linda think of the plan?

"I showed Linda the plan of our trip. She wasn't exactly thrilled about having to spend a third night in Frankfurt in that super expensive hotel. Not that I mind too much! And she had some questions about the schedule on Day 1, which certainly looks very busy. But in the end she gave it the green light."

Why does Bella want to make the trip?

"I really think we should make a trip and visit Nick. It's not an excuse to get out of town for a while, I promise. It's just that I spoke to him yesterday and I didn't like the sound of his voice. Not one little bit."

A To get out of town.
B She's worried about Nick.
C To eat in her favourite restaurant.
opts: To eat in her favourite restaurant.

D because they become hooked

opts: B — and from these safe places, they look for food
C — which increases the chance of new victims
